title: Continuation Coverage Terms Table for Employer Group Contracts
content:
Whether federal COBRA continuation applies to an Employer Group Contract is set by its Cascade Group Dental & Vision segment; the continuation periods, deadlines and premium are the same in every segment.

## Whether COBRA applies

| Segment | Federal COBRA continuation applies |
|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 | No |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus | Yes |

"Yes" means federal COBRA continuation applies (20 or more employees).

## Continuation terms common to every segment

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Continuation after employment ends or hours are reduced | 18 months |
| Total continuation when a qualified beneficiary is disabled | 29 months |
| Total continuation for dependents after a second qualifying event | 36 months |
| Election window | 60 calendar days after the later of coverage loss and the election notice |
| First continuation premium due | within 45 calendar days after the election |
| Grace for each later continuation premium | 30 calendar days |
| Continuation premium | 102 percent of the group rate |
| Employer notice to Cascade after a qualifying event | within 30 calendar days |

## Reading the periods

The 29-month and 36-month figures are totals of continuation, not additions to the 18 months. A hypothetical qualified beneficiary whose continuation would otherwise run 18 months has 29 months of continuation in total when disabled; a dependent who has a second qualifying event has 36 months in total.

## Premium illustration (hypothetical rate)

With a hypothetical group rate of 40.00 dollars for the tier continued, the continuation premium at 102 percent is 40.80 dollars.
